retrain.training_manifest: seven estimated-geometry scenes plus existing warmup, all labels recomputed

V1.scale_handling: label footprint factor cached and inconsistent placements excluded; Query uses fixed raw surfel scale followed by deterministic footprint shrink in the renderer

architecture.ViT: DINOv2 ViT-S/14, 384 channels, output blocks 2/5/8/11, 252x252 token input
architecture.CNN: 1/2:32, 1/4:48, separate prior-motion CNN, four-scale DPT and 64-channel per-pixel decoder
architecture.multiview: two neighboring input frames; sparse quarter-grid eight inverse-depth hypotheses, input depth confidence and edge mask minus motion
architecture.footprint: head exposed, no 1a raster/coverage loss so not calibrated

V2.masking: missing prior weight exactly zero; all-missing strategy has zero weights and 5 m base
V2.failure_action: inspect supervised-pixel sampling, masks and loss; reread only affected check

acquisition.downloads: only ZIP directory, poses and contiguous front RGB/depth windows

C.optical_scope: K16 sampled at each new clip middle frame, both focuses; subpixel labels and hidden layers on all frames

thin_texture_mask.consumer: 13.5(6) masks only zero/LPIPS-context-independent pixel error and L_bokeh pixel losses; 1a has no optical loss

architecture.ViT: DINOv2 ViT-S/14, 384 channels, output blocks 2/5/8/11, 252x252 token input
architecture.CNN: 1/2:32, 1/4:48, separate prior-motion CNN, four-scale DPT and 64-channel per-pixel decoder
architecture.multiview: two neighboring input frames; sparse quarter-grid eight inverse-depth hypotheses, input depth confidence and edge mask minus motion
architecture.footprint: head exposed, no 1a raster/coverage loss so not calibrated
architecture.prior_choice: learned per-pixel masked softmax on three inverse-depth priors, quarter-scale + pixel logits
architecture.boundary_sampling: equal-size strata where available up to 8192 per label, weighting 2:1 for all three terms
architecture.neighbor_visibility: retains round1 supporting view evidence; target basis is learned

training.starting_parameters: new geometry heads, same frozen DINOv2 weight as round 1; no round-1 network warm start
training.selection: fixed last step; validation reads scores only

controls.optimizer: round1 AdamW and learning rate, no change from dev scores

training.curve_recording: CSV means by tier and fixed 100-step block, raw per-step data in run output

goal_boundary_not_worse.rule: equal or lower paired boundary-front CoC MAE

conclusion_scope: given poses, same three development scenes, geometry only; joint data/network/loss changes cannot be individually attributed
